entities.summary: Ayyubid, a notable figure in the history of Syria, associated with Crusader Period and Saladin (1174–1291). Preceded by Zengi captures Edessa — triggers the Second Crusade and Second Crusade. Their legacy influenced Saladin defeats the Crusaders at Hattin and recaptures Jerusalem and Mongol invasion devastates Aleppo and Damascus.
